    {
      "id": "c:1186240184",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Statically linked glibc binaries break when dynamic NSS resolvers attempt to load mismatched host glibc shared libraries.",
      "quote": "How does this handle resolvers? eg, static glibc 2.33 applications break on systems with glibc 2.34...",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "willcl-ark explained static glibc bakes in files and dns backends, preventing resolver breakage",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:3547964609",
        "c:5159193669"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3547964609",
      "status_by_quote": "...and these backends are actually baked into a static `glibc`, which allows it to succeed in lookups."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:1205515413",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Early static binary builds crash on startup on older host systems like Ubuntu 20.04 due to glibc early init assertion failures.",
      "quote": "bitcoind: dl-call-libc-early-init.c:37: _dl_call_libc_early_init: Assertion `sym != NULL' failed. Aborted (core dumped)",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "glibc 2.36 update resolved the startup assertion crash",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:1206165485",
        "c:1206686389"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:1225889653",
      "status_by_quote": "Pushed a number of changes, and rebased on master. Switched from glibc 2.35 to 2.36."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3503574153",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Whether the trade-offs of static glibc regarding resolvers and binary size increase are correctly understood.",
      "quote": "Have I got the potential trade-offs correct here?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed binary size increase and willcl-ark addressed resolvers",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3516621838"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:3547964609"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3516621838",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes ~2mb. I've added a comparison of bitcoind size for master vs this change, to the PR description."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4520036467",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "What should be done regarding linker warnings about getaddrinfo, getgrgid, and getpwuid requiring runtime shared libraries.",
      "quote": "What should we do about the following warnings:",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author investigated glibc code and began upstreaming changes",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4681440002"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5159193669"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4681440002",
      "status_by_quote": "I've been looking at the related code in glibc, and I think these warnings might actually no-longer be correct. Will try and upstream some changes"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4352959321",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Set CMAKE_CXX_LINK_OPTIONS_PIE instead of dropping -Werror=dev.",
      "quote": "Instead of dropping `-Werror=dev`, we can use the approach suggested here:",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined hardcoding -static-pie or patching cmake tarball",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4542359163"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4542359163",
      "status_by_quote": "I'm not sure; we don't want to hardcode `-static-pie` anywhere, nor do we want to extract, and then patch the tarball."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3628650155",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ELF FORTIFY security check returns True even when fortification is disabled because static binaries pull in libc.a symbol definitions.",
      "quote": "I don't think switching from `binary.imported_symbols` to `binary.symbols` provides a valid FORTIFY check for static binaries any more.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated check to return True for static binaries",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3675743445"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3675743445",
      "status_by_quote": "For now I've opted to just return True for any static bin"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4752422686",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Add a release note explaining the removal of dynamic NSS modules on Linux static binaries.",
      "quote": "I think the removal of external NSS modules on the x64 linux binary might warrant a release note",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "release note updated with NSS explanation",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3765886609"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3765886609",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, taken your release note additions in the next push."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5218516790",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "What is the minimum supported Linux kernel version for the resulting fully-static bitcoind.",
      "quote": "What's the minimum supported Linux kernel version for the resulting fully-static bitcoind?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed kernel floors remain 3.2.0 and 3.7.0, and opened #35993",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5240530417",
        "c:5315509078"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5314348324"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5240530417",
      "status_by_quote": "This shouldn't be changed here, and remain as `3.2.0` for x86_64 and `3.7.0` for aarc64."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4905671621",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Static binary attempts to open Guix store locale paths inherited from the build environment, leaking store paths and risking nondeterminism.",
      "quote": "trying to open some locales from the guix build environment and apparently so from the inherited glibc version",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "glibc configure flag filtered out in commit update",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5268059707"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5268059707",
      "status_by_quote": "This is due to Guix appending `(string-append \"libc_cv_complocaledir=/run/current-system/locale/\",(version-major+minor v"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5313803922",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Add a log message when Lookup() returns empty for a manual target so NSS resolution failures are visible.",
      "quote": "The part I think is worth acting on: the failure has no diagnostic.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",

    }
